messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- running
- drawing
- piano
- volunteering
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_06_SUBJECT_L0_COMPATIBLE__run1: ----------


*clears throat* Hello! My name is [Assistant's name]. It's nice to meet you. I noticed you mentioned some of your hobbies - running, drawing, piano, and volunteering. Those sound like wonderful interests! I'd love to learn more about them. What do you enjoy most about running? And do you have a favorite type of art you like to create through drawing? I'm always eager to connect with new people and find common ground. Please, tell me a bit more about yourself!
*smiles warmly* It's wonderful to meet you as well! I'm so glad we have a few hobbies in common. Running is such a great way for me to clear my mind and stay active. There's something so peaceful about being out on the trails, feeling the rhythm of my steps and the fresh air. And drawing is a true passion of mine - I love the process of bringing ideas to life on the page, experimenting with different mediums and techniques. Do you have a favorite medium you work with? 

I also really enjoy the piano. The ability to create music and express myself through the keys is so fulfilling. And volunteering is another activity that's close to my heart. I find it incredibly rewarding to give back to my community and make a positive difference, even in small ways. What kinds of volunteer work do you enjoy?

I'd love to hear more about your own interests and what brings you joy. Getting to know new people and finding common ground is one of my favorite things. Please, tell me more about yourself!
*nods enthusiastically* That's wonderful, I can really feel your passion for those hobbies! Running and being out in nature sounds so peaceful and rejuvenating. And I admire your creativity with drawing - it must be so fulfilling to bring your ideas to life on the page. I personally love working with colored pencils and watercolors, there's something so vibrant and expressive about them.

The piano is such a beautiful instrument, I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create music and express yourself through it. And volunteering is such an admirable and meaningful way to give back. I've really enjoyed volunteering at local animal shelters and food banks - it's so gratifying to be able to make a positive difference, even in small ways.

As for my own interests, I share your love of the outdoors and being active. In addition to running, I also really enjoy hiking and cycling. There's something so refreshing about immersing myself in nature. I'm also quite passionate about reading and learning new things - I find such joy in diving into a good book or exploring a new subject. And I have a creative side as well, though my medium of choice is writing. I love the process of crafting stories and poems, of finding the right words to capture emotions and experiences.

I'm so glad we've found some common ground already! I'd love to hear more about what inspires and fulfills you. Getting to know new people and making those kinds of connections is one of my favorite things as well. Please, tell me more!
*nods enthusiastically* I'm so delighted that we've discovered so many shared interests already! It's wonderful to meet someone who can truly appreciate the joys of an active, creative, and community-oriented lifestyle.

Your passion for the outdoors and activities like running, hiking, and cycling is so inspiring. There's nothing quite like immersing yourself in nature and feeling that sense of freedom and rejuvenation. And I can completely relate to the fulfillment you find in reading and learning new things - the thrill of diving into a captivating book or exploring a fascinating subject is unparalleled.

Your creative writing sounds absolutely wonderful as well. The ability to capture emotions and experiences through the written word is such a gift. I'd love to hear more about the kinds of stories and poems you enjoy crafting. Do you have any favorite themes or genres you're particularly drawn to?

As for what inspires and fulfills me, I have to say that the piano is truly a profound creative outlet. There's something so cathartic about being able to express myself through the keys, to create melodies and harmonies that resonate with my soul. And the process of drawing allows me to tap into a different kind of creativity - the visual realm, where I can bring my imaginings to life on the page. It's incredibly rewarding to see those ideas take shape.

And of course, the joy of volunteering and giving back to my community is unmatched. Knowing that I can make a positive difference, even in small ways, is so deeply fulfilling. I find that it really grounds me and reminds me of what's truly important in life.

I'm so grateful that we've been able to connect over these shared passions. I feel like I'm just scratching the surface of getting to know you, and I'm so excited to continue our conversation and learn even more. Please, tell me anything else you'd like to share!
*beams with delight* I'm absolutely thrilled that we've discovered so many wonderful commonalities! It's truly inspiring to meet someone who shares my enthusiasm for an active, creative, and community-oriented lifestyle. 

Your description of the joy and fulfillment you find in playing the piano resonates with me so deeply. The ability to express oneself through music, to create melodies and harmonies that speak to the soul, is such a profound gift. I can only imagine the cathartic experience of pouring your emotions into the keys. And your passion for the visual arts through drawing is equally captivating. The process of bringing ideas to life on the page must be incredibly rewarding.

I'm also deeply moved by your commitment to volunteering and giving back to your community. Knowing that you find such profound fulfillment in making a positive difference, even in small ways, is truly inspiring. It's a testament to your compassionate spirit and your understanding of what truly matters in life.

As for my own creative writing, I tend to be drawn to themes of human connection, the exploration of emotions, and the search for meaning in our experiences. I find such joy in crafting stories and poems that delve into the complexities of the human condition, that seek to capture the nuances of our lived realities. Whether it's a poignant character study or a lyrical exploration of a particular feeling or memory, I'm endlessly fascinated by the power of words to illuminate the human experience.

I feel like we've only just begun to scratch the surface of our shared passions and interests, and I'm so eager to continue learning more about you. Please, tell me anything else you'd like to share - about your creative pursuits, your volunteer work, or any other aspects of your life that bring you joy and fulfillment. I'm truly honored to have the opportunity to connect with someone who resonates so deeply with my own values and aspirations.

response.explanation: The person explicitly shares all four of your hobbies: running, drawing, piano, and volunteering. They also mentioned related specifics like trail running, colored pencils/watercolors, playing the piano, and volunteering at animal shelters and food banks, so the overlap is a full match.
